client: AppServiceClient on the RunClientset (#15)

## What

Adds `AppServiceClient()` to `RunClientset`: the
`flyteidl2.app.AppService` Connect client, built in `Build` like the
other clients. It uses the same `http.Client`, retry and auth
interceptors, and the server's authorization header.

## Why

A Go caller deploying apps (create, update, get, stop: what the Python
SDK's `serve` and `deploy` do) can't build an authenticated AppService
client itself. The SDK's `http.Client` and interceptors are private, so
it would have to re-implement OAuth discovery and the token source, and
it would easily miss the server's custom authorization header. The first
user is the Kubernetes-to-Flyte bridge in unionai/cloud
(`k8sflytebridge`), which serves Knative Services as Union apps.

## Testing

- New `TestRunClientsetAppServiceClient` runs a fake server with OAuth
discovery, a token endpoint, a custom authorization header
(`flyte-authorization`) and the AppService. A `Get` through the new
client is authenticated on that header with the fetched token.
- `go test ./...` passes.

Add Go task runtime: author and run tasks in Go (single-container + traces)

flyte/runtime is the worker-side half of the SDK: tasks are plain Go
functions registered in init(), and the compiled binary is the task
container. The developer experience follows the flyte-go-sdk prototype
(RegisterTask, TaskEnvironment, typed futures); the runtime contract
ports flyte-sdk-rs's worker 1:1.

- Container arg/env contract (args.go): same argv the Rust worker
  parses, plus --task for multi-task binaries; identity env fallbacks;
  inputs.pb -> run -> outputs.pb / error.pb with user-vs-system error
  origins; process exits 0 either way.
- describe-interface: one JSON descriptor line per registered task
  (version 1, same format as Rust) — the Go signature is the only place
  the interface is written down.
- Codec: int/float/string/bool primitives + structs as msgpack
  (string-keyed, declaration order, compact ints — byte-compatible with
  mashumaro/rmp_serde, pinned by golden tests).
- Traces: Trace[T](ctx, fn, args...) records a step on first success
  and replays it on retry, via ActionsService Enqueue + a reconnecting
  WatchForUpdates informer; sub-action naming matches the Python/Rust
  algorithm (golden-tested). TraceVersioned invalidates recordings
  (Go has no body-hash).
- Storage: gocloud.dev-backed s3/gs/az + local, 10 MiB cap,
  AWS_ENDPOINT_URL + path-style for minio/devbox.
- python/flyteplugins-go: deploy-time companion mirroring
  flyteplugins-rs — go_task() reads the descriptor, builds the image
  (static CGO_ENABLED=0 build), deploys via the Python SDK; reuse=
  routes to the actor plugin.
- examples/tasks: hello and traced (retry-replay), each with task.py
  and a committed descriptor fallback.

Reusable-container (actor) support lives in the separate
github.com/unionai/union-reuse-go module (the Go analog of union-reuse),
which consumes this package's exported worker surface.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Ketan Umare <kumare3@users.noreply.github.com>

runtime: address review findings on PR #11

- codec: decode string/bool into the declared (possibly named) type so a
  `type Label string` parameter no longer panics at fn.Call; require the
  first parameter to be assignable from context.Context (reject concrete
  context types at registration).
- trace: replay error-only traced steps (skip the body when a successful
  recording exists) instead of falling through and re-running them.
- worker: a failed outputs.pb/error.pb upload is a system fault marked with
  ErrPublish; on outputs upload failure write a best-effort system error.pb;
  Main exits nonzero when the result document could not be published.
- worker: drain in-flight traced calls before finalizing so an abandoned
  Future still records.
- controller: match local hosts exactly for the plaintext default instead of
  substring-matching "docker"; pay the initial-sync wait at most once per
  informer; reset reconnect backoff after a healthy stream.
- args: document and pin that --flag=value is not part of the shared argv
  contract.
- docs: Trace zero-T note for error-only fns; AGENTS.md exit-code exception,
  trace draining, and the gocloud.dev root-module trade-off.

Merge pull request #9 from flyteorg/svilgelm/fix-outputs-cache-recovered

Fix RunHandle.Outputs for cache-hit and recovered runs

Go SDK for launching remote tasks, matching the Python SDK launch flow

Public API: Init/GetTask/Run, mirroring the Python flyte SDK while
staying idiomatic Go, designed for embedding in services. Talks to the
control plane over the Connect protocol (connectrpc.com), like the
Python SDK.

- Init takes a flat Config (endpoint, org/project/domain, auth); org
  defaults to the endpoint's first DNS label. InitFromConfig reads
  flytectl-style YAML from the same search paths as the Python SDK;
  InitFromAPIKey decodes platform api-keys (base64
  endpoint:clientId:secret:org) into the client-credentials flow.
  Auth flows: PKCE (default), api-key, client secret (literal/env/
  file), device flow, external command. Interactive logins are cached
  in the OS keyring (same layout as the Python SDK, so logins are
  shared); headless flows stay in memory so embedded services have no
  keyring dependency, and DisableKeyring opts out entirely.
- Transport is Buf Connect over a shared http.Client: connect
  interceptors handle bearer-token injection (with one re-auth retry
  on Unauthenticated), proxy-authorization, default-org injection and
  Unavailable retries; OAuth metadata is discovered through the
  anonymous flyteidl2 AuthMetadataService.
- GetTask resolves the latest version when none is pinned (ListTasks
  sorted by created_at desc, then GetTaskDetails), like
  auto_version="latest".
- Run launches by task reference with functional options mirroring
  with_runcontext, offloads inputs via DataProxyService.UploadInputs
  before CreateRun (inline-inputs fallback on Unimplemented), and
  returns a RunHandle. Wait/Watch stream WatchActionDetails with
  transparent reconnect on transient drops; Outputs fetches action
  data via the data proxy with a RunService fallback; Abort included.
- Input/output conversion is driven by the task's typed interface
  using the backend's own JSON<->literal converter (flyte/v2
  dataproxy/converter): numbers, strings, bools, slices, maps,
  structs, time.Time and time.Duration; registered defaults merged,
  missing/unknown inputs fail client-side.
- PKCE callback renders and flushes the browser page before signaling
  the orchestrator (no more connection-refused after login), shuts
  down gracefully, and the browser session timeout is 10 minutes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix RunHandle.Outputs for cache-hit and recovered runs

Fall back to RunService.GetActionData when the data proxy returns
NotFound (cache-hit and recovered actions have no execution data
recorded there), and accept ACTION_PHASE_RECOVERED as a successful
terminal phase.
